question: The Modern Periodic Table has 18 vertical columns known as 'groups' and _______ horizontal rows known as 'periods'.
solution:
The correct answer is __**7**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Modern Periodic Table is arranged in 7 horizontal rows called periods.
 
• Each period corresponds to the number of electron shells in the atoms of the elements in that row.
 
• The periods are numbered from 1 to 7, starting from the top to the bottom of the table.
 
• The length of each period increases as you move down the periodic table because higher periods contain more elements due to the increase in the number of available orbitals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Groups:**

 
 
• There are 18 vertical columns in the Modern Periodic Table known as groups.
 
• Elements in the same group have similar chemical properties and the same number of valence electrons.
 
• Groups are numbered from 1 to 18, starting from the leftmost column to the rightmost column of the table.
 
• Examples include Group 1 (Alkali metals), Group 2 (Alkaline earth metals), Group 17 (Halogens), and Group 18 (Noble gases).
 
 
 
• **Periods:**
 
 
• The horizontal rows in the periodic table are called periods.
 
• Each period indicates the principal energy level that is being filled with electrons.
 
• Period 1 has 2 elements (Hydrogen and Helium), Periods 2 and 3 have 8 elements each, Periods 4 and 5 have 18 elements each, and Periods 6 and 7 have 32 elements each.
 
• The properties of elements gradually change as you move across a period from left to right.
 
 
 
• **Periodic Law:**
 
 
• The Modern Periodic Table is based on the periodic law, which states that the properties of elements are a periodic function of their atomic numbers.
 
• This means that elements are arranged in order of increasing atomic number, and elements with similar properties recur at regular intervals.
 
 
 
• **Electron Configuration:**
 
 
• Electron configuration refers to the distribution of electrons in the orbitals of an atom.
 
• It follows the Aufbau principle, Hund's rule, and the Pauli exclusion principle.
 
• The electron configuration of an element determines its position in the periodic table and its chemical behavior.
